name: brand creator
tagline: Logos and brand kits from a company name
rationale: A lowercase b assembled from two separate parts, a black stem and an orange bowl, says that a brand is built from simple pieces. Calm lowercase Geist keeps it in the developer tool family next to Vercel and Linear.

colors.idea: Kiln Orange #F2541B: a warm signal color in a black and blue developer tool field.

symbol.idea: A b made of a stem and a bowl that do not touch: two simple parts, one letter.

wordmark.idea: Geist semibold, lowercase and tight: precise and quiet, like the tools developers already trust.

alternatives.label: Option 2: heavier word
alternatives.why: Inter Extra Bold reads louder at small sizes.

alternatives.label: Option 3: corner and dot
alternatives.why: A frame corner and a dot: the space a logo lives in. More abstract.
